mission: Build an isolated executable candidate multi-surface Control UI for Plan de acción / Universal Control, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital / Study Library and Alumnos / página docente. Each surface must expose durable-intent/change-thread status, active workers, returned changes, local integration state, preview/open action and useful free-worker capacity. Live remains a read-only projection, never source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: executable or reopenable candidate artifact exists under the authorized candidate scope
all four target surfaces are represented with the required control-plane fields
candidate consumes a typed durable data model rather than hard-coding authority claims into UI logic
tests cover four-surface completeness, authority separation and no fake progress/served promotion
evidence/receipts are machine-auditable and no global authority is self-promoted

omitted_but_available_refs: surface-specific archaeology returns not required for isolated candidate scaffolding
unresolved served routes deliberately omitted rather than guessed
contradictions_surfaced: A control surface may display derived telemetry but must not become the source of durable worker or authority state.
Prepared four-surface loops are not equivalent to proved local integration; unknown or unproven states must render explicitly as such.
Exactly one Universal Control remains global, so this artifact is an isolated control-surface candidate rather than a second served shell.

planned_checkpoints: CP1 inspect reusable current control/live/page-loop artifacts and define candidate data contract
CP2 build executable static candidate using typed derived-state input
CP3 add invariants/tests for all four surfaces, authority separation and no fabricated progress
CP4 self-critique responsive/operability and repair candidate
CP5 persist machine-auditable evidence + RETURN and close run
